verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party acceptable-use policy, terms of use, or anti-abuse statement governing how stealth mode, Ultra Stealth, or CAPTCHA solving may be used. The first-party docs only describe the evasion features themselves. A single community remark says an 'ethical scraping' docs page was added, but no vendor content or quote is provided, so there is nothing published by the vendor that an engineer could point to.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can point to the vendor's published acceptable-use and anti-abuse posture governing what its stealth and automation features may be used for
